effect: Both defenses are now connected to the body, and the result clarifies that they catch many inhaled particles and microbes, not all of them.
reaction: The two insets clearly show where each defense works.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the defenses was most worthwhile: the cutaway showed mucus clearance and white blood cells working in different places.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the finished defenses to the body felt mostly like a final fitting rather than a new idea.

surprise.text: I wasn't sure how the white cell would catch a bacterium; seeing it surround and break the bacterium apart made that clearer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the final body connection was the only offered combination and added little new understanding.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: seeing two defenses work in different locations was interesting, though the final fitting was predictable.
